learnings.rule: Discovery must never depend on a single paid source: always run guest search + free APIs even when Apify is healthy
Every bot-facing link must be regenerable: send signed URLs only with a note of expiry
Wave operators must export token aliases before notify_bots.py runs, else silent NO TOKEN
CV generation always retries through the LLM chain before declaring failure - a single provider 503 is not an incident

When LinkedIn search pages return empty after first load: treat as temporary block, pause the wave immediately, never retry-hammer; resume only after block eases and credits renewed, then throttle cycle speed on first hour back
Package generation batches: max 2 cv_gen runs per command to stay under tool timeouts; never batch 4+
Both assistants write to one repo: always git pull --rebase BEFORE any push; keep bank.json and data/bank.json identical (single source of truth) after every merge

When a GitHub Actions job fails before runner assignment (runner_id=0, no steps/logs), classify it as runner-start-failure and alert immediately; do not attribute it to the last known workflow error without evidence.
